## About
El Monte Transmission is a family-owned and operated shop on Baldwin Ave, started by John Rodriguez. We work on transmissions and clutches for foreign and domestic vehicles, including cars, trucks and RVs.
We keep it simple. We diagnose your vehicle and only do the repairs that are necessary, at fair and honest prices. Se habla español.
Neighbors have given us a 4.7 rating across 66 Google reviews. Financing is available upon approval, so give us a call and tell us what your car is doing.

## Services
- Transmission rebuild: Full rebuilds and restoration when your transmission needs more than a small fix.
- Transmission repair: Repairs to gaskets, switches, sensors and more, ideally before a small problem turns into a big one.
- Transmission maintenance: Regular service to help keep your transmission from breaking down, for foreign and domestic vehicles.
- Transmission diagnosis: We find out what is going on with your transmission at no charge. (Free)
- Clutch service: Clutch adjustments, install kits and slave cylinders for cars, trucks, RVs, foreign cars and more.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We work on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: Do you offer financing?
A: Yes. Financing is available upon approval.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM. We are closed Sunday. Call ahead about Saturday.
